motion.name: tape-forward
motion.value: 120ms scale(1.025) with a deeper shadow, no translation
motion.purpose: Hover brings the tape toward the viewer; reduced motion keeps it still

motion.name: tape-open
motion.purpose: A clicked tape comes out toward the viewer before its page opens

layout.name: shelf-stack
layout.value: one spine per row in a centered stack of at most 760px; spine proportions 187:25
layout.purpose: True VHS spine proportions at every window size
